name: Hydratec Industries NV
summary: Hydratec Industries NV, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial systems and plastic components for food, health, and mobility markets in the Netherlands, rest of Europe, Asia, North America, South America, Africa, the Middle East, and Oceania. The company operates through two segments: Industrial Systems and Hightech Components. It develops and produces sterilized product handling systems; and automated packaging solutions, including packaging for sterilized food in pouches, cans, and jars, as well as meal salads and agrifood in bags, nets, boxes, and crates.
